summary: Backend + frontend E2E tested for AutoDelegate. All 13 backend pytest tests pass (create meeting, analyze routing per sample, edit action, execute action gating and demo simulation, upload-audio validation, 404 handling). Full frontend flow home->mapping->analysis->approval->execution verified with the Login Bug Standup sample: 3 actions produced with correct persons (Priya/Arun/Ravi) and tools (jira/jira/calendar), edit dialog saves, execute in demo mode shows SIMULATED tag on each execution card, new-meeting resets. Demo-mode-toggle correctly flips indicator (DEMO MODE <-> LIVE MODE) and hides/shows the demo banner.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning in console) — add DialogDescription or aria-describedby

action_items: Optional: Add DialogDescription to edit-action-dialog to remove Radix a11y console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /extract-actions calls analyze_meeting(payload) directly then indexes ['actions'] - but analyze_meeting returns full meeting doc via get_meeting_or_404 (dict). Works but is inconsistent; the fallback branch also awaits analyze_meeting which is a coroutine returning dict - fine. Consider returning consistent shape {'meeting_id','actions'} in both branches.
server.py: STEP_STAGE in App.js skips stage 2 (analysis=3) - visual stepper jumps; minor UX.
integrations.py: real Jira/Gmail/Calendar branches never exercised (no creds); acceptable per demo-mode design.
server.py execute_action: sets status to 'failed' on result.success False but doesn't return non-200 — client relies on execution_result.success flag which is handled.
diarize/analyze_transcript rely on LLM JSON output; _parse_json is robust to code fences but no schema validation — acceptable for MVP.
seed_data_creation: Test meetings prefixed TEST_ created via API during pytest run (not cleaned up; safe for demo DB).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_autodelegate.py, run with `pytest backend/tests -v`. LLM (Gemini 3.1 Pro) reliably produces the expected 3-action mapping for the login-bug sample; allow up to 30s for /api/analyze-meeting. Demo mode always returns SIMULATED with demo:true — this is by design.
